description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh: 等候室ID，用于查询特定等候室的详情。
description.en: The waiting room ID. Specify this parameter to query the details of a specific waiting room.

descriptions.zh: 此API允许您查询指定站点下所有等候室的配置详情，包括启用状态、名称、排队规则等信息。
descriptions.en: This API allows you to query the configuration details of all waiting rooms for a specified site, including the enabled status, name, and queuing rules.
